copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要结构化方法进行产品发现
copy.tagline_en: Guide teams through a full discovery cycle from problem hypothesis to validated solution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs a structured approach to product discovery

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成一个完整的产品探索流程，包括问题框定、客户访谈、综合分析和实验验证，最终输出决策建议。
howto.when: 当你需要系统性地探索问题空间、验证假设，或者启动一个从假设到验证的探索周期时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次从问题假设到验证的探索流程。
我们想验证客户在首次使用时的困惑点。
say.note: 聚焦问题框定与客户访谈。

say.text: 帮我总结这次访谈的洞察并给出下一步决策。
say.note: 进入综合分析与验证阶段。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through a complete discovery cycle including problem framing, customer interviews, synthesis, and experiments, and output decision recommendations.
howto.when_en: Use when you need a structured path through framing, interviews, synthesis, and experiments, typically starting a discovery cycle from hypothesis to validation.

say_en.text: Run a full discovery cycle from hypothesis to validated solution.
Help us validate our hypothesis about onboarding struggles.
say_en.note: Focus on problem framing and interviews.

say_en.text: Synthesize interview insights and recommend next steps.
